message.content:
I’m sorry I don’t have live map data at hand, but I can definitely point you toward finding the nearest Italian spot!  

**If you let me know your city/area (or even just “downtown” vs. “suburbs”), I can narrow down suggestions more specifically.**

In the meantime here’s what you can do right now:

| Option | How to Use It |
|--------|---------------|
| **Google Maps / Apple Maps** | Search “Italian restaurants near [your address]”. Both apps will list options, show ratings, hours, distance, and directions. |
| **Yelp** | Type “Italian” + your zip code; filter by rating, price range, open‑now status, etc. |
| **TripAdvisor** | Good for traveler reviews—search “Italian restaurants” plus your locale. |
| **OpenTable** | If you want to book quickly, look up nearby Italian places and see available tables. |
| **Local Food Apps** | In many cities there’re dedicated food discovery apps like Zomato, Foursquare, or local delivery services that also highlight dining spots. |

Once you’ve found a few candidates, check:
* Distance/time via public transit or driving  
* Current opening hours (some may close early)  
* Recent reviews (look for consistent praise around service & authenticity)

Let me know your exact area and I’ll gladly dig deeper into specific recommendations!
